title: Gate 1 Plan
description: Front matter schema for AGF-NG Gate 1 plan files (docs/plans/*.md)

superseded_by.description: Stable identifier (plan id, or the id of the replacement work item/work order) of what replaced this plan. Declared provenance, matching gate1_approved_by's own convention: the schema requires a non-empty identifier but does not itself resolve or verify that the identifier exists or is correct -- a reviewer confirms that. Required only when status is superseded.

superseded_decision.description: Filename or id of the governor-reviewer coordination decision-record authorizing this disposition. Declared provenance, matching gate1_approved_by's own convention: the schema requires a non-empty value but does not itself verify the record exists or that its author held governor-reviewer authority -- a reviewer confirms that. Required only when status is superseded.

superseded_at.description: UTC disposition timestamp (RFC3339, Z-suffixed). Required only when status is superseded. format: date-time alone accepts any RFC3339 offset (e.g. +02:00); the pattern additionally requires the literal Z (Zulu/UTC) designator, matching this project's own YYYYMMDDThhmmssZ timestamp convention used elsewhere (coordination IDs, gate1_approved_at values in practice).

affected_paths.description: Optional repository-relative paths/globs; ** is allowed only as a whole path segment. `agov plan collision-check` reports overlaps against other live plans advisory-only by default; the agov:governance:plan-collision-gate CI job additionally blocks Gate 1 for an unacknowledged plan-vs-plan overlap -- see `depends_on` and agf/rules/workflow/development-workflow-rule.md's "Affected-paths collision blocking" section.

depends_on.description: Optional list of other plan ids, MR references (!<iid>), or branch names this plan acknowledges an affected_paths overlap with, and has a deliberate sequencing/coordination disposition for. Naming a counterpart here downgrades a detected collision from blocking to informational for this plan; it does not require the counterpart to reciprocate.
